name: Marubeni Corporation
summary: Marubeni Corporation purchases, distributes, and markets industrial and consumer goods. It offers apparel, fashion accessories, household goods, rubber, industrial and textile materials, conveyor belts, tyres, wood chips, pulp, paper and cardboard products, sanitary goods, and smart devices.
